findings.observation: Every supported facade route is Rosenbrock/implicit; an RHS-only public Problem defaults to a finite-difference Jacobian. No general explicit Runge-Kutta implementation was found in crates/*.rs.
findings.impact: Nonstiff calls pay Jacobian/linear-solve costs despite not needing them.
findings.action: Add genuine RHS-only adaptive DOPRI5 path with explicit caller selection and distinct executed-method records.

findings.impact: Reusing it unchanged for a Jacobian-free API requires an artificial derivative or cannot construct the problem.
findings.action: Use a dedicated validated explicit problem/driver interface or additive RHS-only constructor; do not install a fake zero JVP or weaken implicit route checks.

findings.observation: Existing records assume a used derivative provider and protected RODAS5P route.
findings.impact: An explicit implementation could otherwise be mislabeled as finite differences or a Rosenbrock production route.
findings.action: Separate explicit result/record or add NotUsed/explicit variants with accurate method id; keep requested and executed method traceable.

findings.observation: error_scale allocates a fresh Vec; controller already accepts estimator_order as an argument.
findings.impact: Blind helper reuse adds hot-loop allocation and Rosenbrock-specific metadata may misidentify the explicit controller.
findings.action: Reuse controller arithmetic with DOPRI error-estimator order 5 and persistent/streamed scalar-vector error scales preserving zero-scale and overflow rules.

findings.location: new explicit FSAL cache and accepted-state transaction
findings.observation: Last-stage derivative equals next first derivative only at the accepted endpoint with the same RHS/model data.
findings.impact: Promoting a rejected stage or reusing after a model mutation changes the integrated equation.
findings.action: Commit endpoint/state/FSAL atomically; retain base derivative across rejection only when base/model unchanged; invalidate on epoch/state changes. Count failed callbacks before entry.

findings.observation: RHS-only, dimension, and absence of a Jacobian are representation choices, not evidence of nonstiffness.
findings.impact: Unconditional default explicit selection can cause large stiff costs or step-budget failure.
findings.action: Expose explicit caller choice first. Any automatic strategy must be opt-in, preserve accepted state/work, have bounded probing and record fallback/selection reasons.
